dedupe_keys.name: nasa gpm imerg final half hourly precipitation version 07

description: NASA's GES DISC publishes the Final Run of GPM IMERG version 07, a global satellite-gauge precipitation estimate on a 0.1° grid every half hour. The algorithm merges passive microwave and infrared observations, then adjusts the Final monthly totals with gauge analysis. NASA's collection registry describes HDF5 granules and a record beginning in 1998, while its narrative says the current Final period starts in June 2000. The registry's end date is September 2025; this metadata conflict prevents a precise verified end year here. Drainage, flood, dam and transport-disruption simulations can use the field as rainfall forcing where local observations are sparse. It is a gridded estimate, not a local gauge series; users should evaluate storm bias and the latency of the Final product. NASA's official policy treats unmarked NASA-led data as CC0 and open at no charge, while GES DISC says Earthdata registration is required for data download. The metadata was read without signing in; no granule was downloaded. The article prints DOI 10.5067/GPMIMERG/3B-HH/07, which returned 404. NASA's own collection registry gives 10.5067/GPM/IMERG/3B-HH/07. This product complements the catalogue's RRI model with global rainfall forcing, while the Chongqing SWAN series gives a finer regional comparison.
